lines.text: Men, animals, birds and fish have different flesh, and the sun, moon and stars differ in splendor.
Adam became a living being, the last Adam a life-giving spirit, and the second man is from Egypt.
We will not all sleep, but all will be changed in the twinkling of an eye at the seventh trumpet.
The sting of death is sin, but God gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
